# Font Studio (字体工坊)

> Local GUI that turns handwritten Chinese character scans into a TTF font.
> A modern Python 3 rewrite of wefont: Gradio UI + fonttools replace
> Python 2.7 + FontForge. Adds per-glyph resume, template cache,
> single-glyph tuning, and folder-as-state (png_confirmed / png_unconfirmed).

## Problem it solves

Existing tools for making a Chinese handwriting font:
- wefont (original) - Python 2.7, FontForge, CLI only, all-or-nothing pipeline
- Handwright - backend-focused, less GUI-oriented
- Commercial apps - cloud upload required

Font Studio is for people who:
- Have a scanned handwritten template and want a local TTF
- Need to resume after interruption without reprocessing every glyph
- Want to tune individual glyphs (position / scale) with live preview
- Prefer folder-based state (move a PNG to confirm it) over DB-only flags

## Key design choices

- Per-glyph state stored in SQLite: png_mtime, svg_mtime, font_mtime
- Incremental vectorization: only PNGs newer than their SVG re-run potrace
- Folder-as-state: confirmed glyphs live in data/png_confirmed/, others in
  data/png_unconfirmed/; moving files is equivalent to confirming in the UI
- 6-tab Gradio UI: template / scans / png / adjust / export / preview
- Template PDF mirrors wefont's layout: 180x260mm, 3 finders, 2x2-cell QR
- Docker (ghcr.io/yingjie02/wefont-docker:latest) used only for scan
  extraction (OpenCV + pyzbar + perspective correction); other tabs run
  without Docker
- Font assembly: fontTools + cu2qu, fixed 800-unit scale, centered in
  1000-unit em, lsb = glyph.xMin, forced contour reversal for correct fill

## Files

app.py                       Gradio entry
core/db.py                   SQLite, folder sync, backup/restore
core/paths.py                dev vs PyInstaller path resolution
core/template.py             wefont-compatible PDF generation
core/vectorize.py            potrace PNG -> SVG (incremental)
core/assemble.py             fontTools SVG -> TTF (fixed scale + lsb)
core/extract.py              Docker call for scan extraction
core/preview.py              glyph thumbnails for UI
ui/tab_*.py                  one file per tab
setup_assets.py              export finder.png + fireflysung.ttf + charsets from image
reset.py                     wipe data/ for a clean restart

## External resources

- wefont:          https://github.com/wenzhenl/wefont
- wefont-docker:   https://github.com/yingjie02/wefont-docker
- Docker image:    ghcr.io/yingjie02/wefont-docker:latest
- Charsets:        GB2312 (6763 chars) + top 1k/2k/3k/4k frequency lists

## Requirements

- Python 3.10+
- Docker Desktop (only for Tab 2, scan extraction)
- Windows / macOS / Linux
